description: This file defines the DropDownTree class, which extends MBPackageTree and is responsible for representing a tree structure of dropdown packages in the ModuleBuilder module of SuiteCRM. It initializes a tree with nodes obtained from a DropDownBrowser instance and provides a method to retrieve the display name of the tree.

classes.name: DropDownTree
classes.description: A class that manages and displays a tree view of dropdown packages within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, extending MBPackageTree.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DropDownTree by creating a Tree object, a DropDownBrowser, and populating the tree with nodes from the browser.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the localized string label for the tree component, representing 'Packages'.
